content:
The introduction pattern and cases pattern PR by @Alvin Tang was just merged. :tada: It implements many new cool features, here are the ones I am the most excited about (see the PR description for a full list):

  • Error messages in context and introduction patterns are now localized to the actual part of the pattern that fails.
  • Pure patterns now support rcases syntax for destructing pure variables and assumptions.
  • We have now all introduction patterns from Rocq, including // (calling itrivial), /= (calling simp), //=, *, **, {H} (clearing H), {$H} (framing H), and !% (pure introduction).
  • The introduction patterns and cases patterns now have doc strings that explain what they do on hover.
    Give these new features a try and let us know if you have any feedback!
The change for destructing pure props is especially great :)
